hypothesis: Adding the degree-4 Hermite term of Theorem 3 back to the covariance twin (first Edgeworth correction, oracle Sigma_0 and kappa_4) closes the closure gap wherever the expansion converges: the fraction closed -> 1 as t grows on every family with an exponential moment; it diverges below the crossover; on Student-t it cannot close the tail-dominated part.
design: E01's closure protocol (512 chains, rng tag 'e01-closure', rep 0, grid (801, 8)) at the twelve levels plus 3.5 and 4.0 for laplace, bimodal, uniform, student(5): relative score error of S^G, S^G + grad eps (linear) and S^G + grad eps/(1+eps) (log) against tree-exact BP; fraction of the squared gap closed.
predeclared_analysis: Per level and family: gap closed; the level above which the log form closes more than 90 %; pooled error over the twelve levels for the three estimators.
motivation: Registered during the 18-19 September audit (reports/audit-2026-09-18.tex); the scratch computation that motivated it was run first on the laptop and is reproduced here under provenance.
